fields.description: Enter one JSON object. Worked example: {"mode": "fixed", "fields": ["doc_id: str", "page_count: int", "note: str?"]}. Every entry in "fields" is the string "name: type", where type is one of str, int, float, bool, any, and a trailing "?" marks the field optional ("note: str?" is an optional string). Field names must be valid Python identifiers — write "doc_id", not "doc-id" or "doc.id". Modes: "fixed" accepts exactly these fields, "flexible" accepts these plus any extras the data carries, and "observed" infers every field from the data — with "observed" leave "fields" out entirely ({"mode": "observed"}).
fields.label: Schema
fields.name: schema

fields.description: Fields this transform requires in input. Used for DAG validation to catch missing field errors at config time. For templates, use elspeth.core.templates.extract_jinja2_fields() to discover fields.
fields.label: Required Input Fields
fields.name: required_input_fields

fields.description: Where the JSON text comes from: 'blob' reads the payload store via blob_ref_field, 'field' reads text_field.
fields.label: Source
fields.name: source

fields.description: Input field containing a payload-store content hash. Defaults to 'blob_ref'.
fields.label: Blob Ref Field
fields.name: blob_ref_field

fields.description: Input field containing the blob's normalized Content-Type, used to select the parse format. Defaults to 'blob_content_type'.
fields.label: Content Type Field
fields.name: content_type_field

fields.description: Input row field holding the text to parse, when source is 'field'. Defaults to 'content'.
fields.label: Text Field
fields.name: text_field

fields.description: Parse format. Required when source is 'field'. When source is 'blob' and this is omitted, the format is inferred fail-closed from the blob's stored content type.
fields.label: Format
fields.name: format

fields.description: Optional top-level object key containing the array of records. Omitted means the document's top level is the array.
fields.label: Data Key
fields.name: data_key

fields.description: Record keys this transform emits as row fields, each typed 'any'. Required: JSON records carry no header row, so nothing else can tell downstream validation which fields the emitted rows will have.
fields.label: Fields
fields.name: fields

fields.description: Optional mapping from normalized JSON record keys to final pipeline field names.
fields.label: Field Mapping
fields.name: field_mapping

fields.description: Encoding used to decode the JSON blob.
fields.label: Encoding
fields.name: encoding

fields.description: Whether to emit the record index within the parsed JSON document.
fields.label: Include Record Index
fields.name: include_record_index

fields.description: Output field receiving the zero-based JSON record index.
fields.label: Record Index Field
fields.name: record_index_field

fields.description: Maximum rows emitted for one input document.
fields.label: Max Output Rows
fields.name: max_output_rows

fields.description: Maximum payload size accepted from the blob store. Applies to source='blob' only — a source='field' document is already resident in the row, so max_output_rows is its bound.
fields.label: Max Blob Bytes
fields.name: max_blob_bytes
